vb_textbox.text: You are always faced with a choice of either a Brown or Green Gnome or a Red or Purple Gnome. The previous participant said they started with the Brown and Green and got good results between 6-9 mushrooms and switched when the numbers started to drop to like 2-3. I started off with this strategy but found it didnt really work however it did eventually. Sometimes you have to play with it but youll be able to tell when to stick with Brown/Green and when to switch to Red/Purple. Some rounds have 0 nomatter what though. Once you find the groove of Brown/Green or Red/Purple keep sticking with it until the number drops and then swap it. Good luck!
